• Can-Am Maverick X3 2-Seater (1000cc Turbo): AED 1,000 for 30 minutes | AED 1,500 for 1 hour
• Can-Am Maverick X3 Max 4-Seater: AED 1,350 for 30 minutes | AED 1,900 for 1 hour
• Polaris RZR 1000cc 1-Seater: AED 600 for 30 minutes | AED 900 for 1 hour
All rentals include FIA roll-cage safety, fitted helmets, dust goggles, backup support team, and leader marshal guide escort. No driving license required! Drivers must be 16+. 100% Pay on Arrival.

preview:
Marhaban! For 2 adults, our Evening Desert Safari comes to a total of AED 240 (AED 120 per adult).

This includes complimentary 4x4 doorstep pickup and drop-off across Dubai and Sharjah, 45-minute red dune bashing in Lahbab, sandboarding, camel rides, a 5-star live BBQ dinner buffet (with vegetarian and vegan options), and live cultural shows (Tanoura dance, Fire show, and Belly dance).

If you prefer your own exclusive vehicle, our Private VIP Land Cruiser 300 Series is AED 850 flat rate (up to 6 guests). All safari bookings feature 100% Pay on Arrival!

preview:
We take special care to ensure you and your family feel completely safe and comfortable. Because high-dune bashing is bumpy with sudden crest drops, it is not recommended for expectant mothers or toddlers under 3 years old.

However, you certainly do not have to miss out on the magic of the desert! We can arrange a gentle, scenic direct transfer to our Bedouin camp along smooth, flat desert roads without any rough off-roading. While others do the dune drive, your family can relax comfortably in our shaded Majlis, watch the golden sunset, take gentle camel rides, take photos with our hunting falcon, and enjoy the live BBQ dinner and evening shows in complete peace of mind.
